text: - Filed chirp#47 for the **broken nav bar** (8 cramped tabs, mid-word wrapping) — which I should have caught by just looking. [...] **Android read-path is genuinely validated and screenshot-verified** — onboarding (both nsec-import and create-account), timeline with resolved names, profile, DMs, relays, account, wallet, outbox, diagnostics all work under real interaction, no crashes or blank screens. The two bugs you flagged are fixed: profile resolution (a real race in `KernelProfileHost` — a collector attaching after the single no-replay event fired) and the nav bar (8 tabs → 5 + a More screen). One honesty note the agent made explicit: it couldn't photograph a "before" for the profile race because a loopback relay resolves too fast to reliably trigger it — the fix is code-level verified, not before/after-photographed. I'd rather you know that than have it claimed as a clean visual proof.
